_comment: What the installer (aw library install) pins. A lock file is compiled per Python minor: the core lock was compiled on Python 3.9, the structure lock on Python 3.10. requirements_sha256 is the sha256 of the requirements file; a test keeps it in step.

core.purpose: index a book from its hinted table of contents (summaries through LiteLLM)

structure.purpose: core plus PageIndex structure detection, for a book with no hinted table of contents
structure.extra_note: WeasyPrint (renders Trove text to a PDF for structure detection) is not in the lock; it also needs the pango system library.
